description.value: Cities generate vermin, and someone has to manage the problem. You worked the warrens beneath markets and warehouses, the cellars of inns, the spaces inside walls that nobody else thought about. It was filthy, essential work that kept you in close contact with the parts of urban life that other people preferred not to acknowledge. You know how cities actually function — their hidden geography, their overlooked populations, their invisible labor.

system.features: Invisible City: You mapped the forgotten infrastructure beneath the streets: cellar networks, drainage channels, service passages, and the spaces inside walls that no one else thinks about. You can navigate the hidden architecture of urban environments and enter buildings through routes that no guard has thought to watch. The city's overlooked workforce — night laborers, maintenance workers, porters, and sewermen — recognizes you as one of their own and will share information freely.
